description: This file defines the class OA_UpgradeAuditor, which manages upgrade audit logs, backup tables, and related operations within the Revive Adserver project. It includes constants, class methods for querying and updating audit data, and handles database interactions for upgrade processes.

classes.name: OA_UpgradeAuditor
classes.description: A class that manages upgrade audit logs, backup tables, and related operations for the Revive Adserver project.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the auditor, calling parent init and setting up the database auditor.

methods.name: _initDBAuditor
methods.description: Initializes the database auditor object if not already initialized.

methods.name: getNextUpgradeActionId
methods.description: Retrieves the next auto-increment ID for the upgrade_action log table.

methods.name: setUpgradeActionId
methods.description: Sets the current upgrade action ID from the database.

methods.name: getUpgradeActionId
methods.description: Returns the current upgrade action ID.

methods.name: queryAuditByUpgradeId
methods.description: Fetches all audit records for a specific upgrade action ID.

methods.name: queryAuditArtifactsByUpgradeId
methods.description: Fetches audit artifacts related to a specific upgrade action ID.

methods.name: queryAuditBackupTablesByUpgradeId
methods.description: Fetches backup table audit records for a specific upgrade action ID.

methods.name: queryAuditAddedTablesByUpgradeId
methods.description: Fetches list of tables added during a specific upgrade action.

methods.name: getBackupTableStatus
methods.description: Retrieves status (size and row count) for backup tables.

methods.name: queryAuditAllDescending
methods.description: Retrieves all upgrade audit records with backup count, ordered descending by ID.

methods.name: cleanAuditArtifacts
methods.description: Deletes backup artifacts and logs for a specific upgrade ID, with optional reason.

methods.name: updateAuditBackupConfDroppedById
methods.description: Updates confbackup column with a reason for deletion.

methods.name: updateAuditBackupLogDroppedById
methods.description: Updates logfile column with a reason for deletion.
